about_the_game:
This is a casual combat - type game.

After players enter the game, they will be in the "Trial Ground 1 - 1" level.

The amount of gold coins and diamonds of the player will be displayed at the top of the game.

There are also welfare and task entrances such as "Seven - day Check - in", "Lucky Turntable" and "Daily Tasks".

In the combat area, the protagonist can be seen attacking monsters with a sword, and there are task prompts on the right (for example, strengthen the attack power to level 2, and diamonds will be rewarded upon completion).

There is also a cultivation function. The "Attack Power", "Life" and "Life Recovery" of the player's character can be strengthened and upgraded by consuming gold coins.

There is also an "Auto - battle" mode, as well as system entrances such as "Protagonist", "Skills", "Pets", "Dungeons" and "Summon", which help players cultivate their characters and advance through the level adventures.
